name: Ikaruga Shikibu
source:
Sumire’s friend and captain of the fencing club. Her family is the descendants of warriors so her skill with the sword is top-class. But her personality and actions are more on the irresponsible side. Aside from her jokes though, she has a side which is frightfully cold-hearted.
